notes.title: Playtest update for 6th January 2025
notes.notes:
👋 Hello Parcel Playtesters! This update brings a few fixes and changes:

- NEW: the scanner conveyor has had an upgrade! It now has a new model, and sends parcels one of three ways: approve sticker attached, deny sticker attached, or no sticker attached. Note: this will break any existing usages of the old scanner conveyor - those scanner conveyors can be removed from your save games as they're no longer useful
[img]https://i.imgur.com/N7O9U2n.gif[/img]
- FIXED: the conveyor joiner now correctly works and no longer gets stuck
- FIXED: contents now spawn back into parcels from save games properly. This will not work on existing broken parcels, only new parcels.

notes.title: Playtest update for 8th December 2024
notes.notes:
👋 Hello Parcel Playtesters! With this update I bring new tools, new conveyors, and general reworks and improvements to automation:

[h2]✈️ New Conveyors[/h2]

The purpose of automation in Parcel Simulator is to make your life easier when sorting parcels. I have listened to your feedback on the playtest, and as a first step towards full-automation I have added a new "diverter" conveyor, specifically for parcel's Cargo Type. This now means that you can automatically sort parcels based on their respective cargo types by combing sets of cargo type diverter conveyors. This is hopefully one step towards a fully automated warehouse.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ck0ES76.png[/img]

[h2]⤴️ Updated Conveyor Belt Models[/h2]

The conveyor belt models have been updated with better geometry (for in-game performance), a wider conveyor base (allowing parcels to fit on better, a lower-to-the-ground profile (meaning you can jump on/over them easier), and belts rather than rollers (because this is somewhat more realistic to sorting centres). These models should now form the basis for future conveyors going forwads.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hdhx2jX.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Olytsxk.png[/img]

[h2]💻 More Room to Work With[/h2]
Linking automation and the inspection table seemed important to many players, so I've made best efforts (without rewriting the game's placement logic) to allow the inspect table to be "nested" in-between multiple conveyor belts. As per the GIF below, you're able to zoom out at the inspection table, grab parcels directly from conveyors, and place them back onto conveyors when done.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i0xG8TY.gif[/img]

[h2] 🔨 New Tools[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PBdDMnd.png[/img]
This update brings two new inspection table tools to the shop: a barcode scanner, and desktop scales. The barcode scanner instantly checks and validates a serial number, meaning you no longer have to type the values in manually into the keypad. The desktop scales automatically weigh, and categorise, a parcel based on it's weight, meaning you can immediately check whether or not the weight class attached matches that of the "accepted weight classes" on the scales.

[h2]🐜 Bugs and Fixes[/h2]
As with every update, plenty of bugs and fixes are in this update.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2DTxAsQ.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Playtest update for 7th November 2024
notes.notes:
Hey playtesters! This update contains performance improvements, tweaks and fixes, and a lovely new feedback form!

[h2]📊 Performance[/h2]
Playtesting from the community found that with even as few as 100 parcels in the scene, FPS would drop to below 30. This simply wasn't good enough, so I've focused heavily on optimising this issue, specifically with parcels in the scene, and have now been able to maintain around 100FPS with 100, 500, and even 1000 parcels in the scene. The next step is to optimise the conveyor belts, as currently they are using unoptimised meshes - this should be available in the next update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SCsLer0.png[/img]

[h2]📋 Feeback Form[/h2]
Feedback in the playtest is absolutely vital, so this update comes with a handy-dandy feedback form. Each feedback submissions submits information about the issue you're facing, a screenshot of your current game state, your save file, and a log file, automatically. This will make it much easier for me to assist with finding and fixing bugs, so please make use of it - I will be reading every single report!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3fEkTFz.png[/img]

[h2]📋 Serial Number Keypad Improvements[/h2]
The serial number keypad now allows you to use the number row, and the numpad, to enter values into the keypad. The keypad now also displays in green/red when you enter a valid/invalid code to make it easier to see when you've entered something correctly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kxvbQYd.png[/img]

[h2]⚙️ Many More Changes and Fixes[/h2]
- Added 2 new soundtracks
- Disable the ability to pickup inspection stickers with E
- Disable click events on the objective panel so you can click through it when hidden at the inspection table
- Parcels move with the denials container when picked up with parcels inside
- Remove the issue of large stacks of parcels making noise whilst colliding together
- Prevented the walking sound from still continuing when entering the inspection table

Thanks for playtesting! 📦📦📦

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p5Hexqn.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest update for 7th October 2024
notes.notes:
Hey playtesters! This update contains a bunch of new things, tweaks, and improvements, getting Parcel Simulator one step closer to a public demo.

[h2]✈️ Cargo Type Doors[/h2]
As you progress through the game and upgrade your warehouse tier, you'll get access to new export doors. Each of these doors will accept a certain group of cargo types, and so you must make sure you're submitting parcels through the correct doors.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fnUj0II.png[/img]

[h2]🩹 Inspection Stickers[/h2]
You must now attach inspection stickers, either approval or denial, to each and every parcel before submitting. These stickers will sometimes come pre-attached, so keep an eye out as these can be instantly submitted.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ao4CfVC.png[/img]

[h2]📈 Upgrades[/h2]
Want faster deliveries? Want larger deliveries? Want delivery doors to automatically load parcels onto conveyor belts? Introducing the warehouse upgrades panel, where you can purchase upgrades for your warehouse!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXu8h4k.png[/img]

[h2]🎉 And Much More![/h2]
This update once again comes with many more updates, improvements and QOL changes, many of which will be lost in this post but hopefully not lost in the gameplay! One large change is the flow of parcel deliveries: parcel deliveries are now continuous and unlimited, meaning you can stash, store and pile up parcels for as long as you so please.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8RBkDxD.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest update for 8th August 2024
notes.notes:
Hey playtesters! This update contains a bunch of new things, tweaks, and improvements, getting Parcel Simulator one step closer to a public demo.

[h2]🪪 Criteria Licences![/h2]
Previously in Parcel Simulator, new parcel criteria would be assigned to you automatically at a relatively arbitrary cadence. Now, licences are directly tied to a given criteria, and once unlocked will mean that all parcels going forward will contain that criteria. Doing so will make your life harder with the new checks, but will also allow you to unlock new warehouse tiers, and in turn more licences.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/TPpRqIE.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]🏗️ Freeplace System[/h2]
To give you a sense of control over your warehouse, you can now freely place many objects including the inspection table, the statistics dashboard, and all inspection items.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/eVEW56q.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]🔎 Inspection Table Overhaul[/h2]
One of the biggest complaints in previous playtests was the interactions at the inspection table not feeling very fluid. Now, you're able to drag items around freely, interact and focus items without them knocking each other off the table, rotate items, and many more things.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/EJA0Ykj.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]🛒 Pallet Improvements[/h2]
Pallets are now much, much better. You'll get a handy snapping system come in to play when you hover over one with a pallet in your hands, allowing you to easily attach and remove parcels to pallets.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/IPNsGPV.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]🖥️ Submit display[/h2]
To make it easier to digest where the income/losses are coming from for each submission, the export screen has had a major overhaul, giving you granular information and detail on each submission. Additionally, it also now costs $5 per submission to encourage parcels to be submitted in batches rather than individually. Finally, the inspection tablet now alerts you with a modal if there is an incorrect submission with the parcel in question that was incorrectly submitted, and the reason for the incorrect submission.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/zySsRRp.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]🚀 And a bunch more stuff![/h2]
A lot of other stuff has changed, be it tweaks and bug fixes, or changes and refactoring to underlying systems. A lot of moving pieces are hard to see, but hopefully have made a big impact still. Happy playtesting!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424010/Parcel_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2DTxAsQ.png[/img][/url]
